messages:
Sara: Postmortem for 2026-03-20 cache-eviction spike. TL;DR: hot-key eviction due to incorrect TTL config + burst of long sequences. Need to assign remediation owners, create JIRA tickets, and map RACI. Please claim items by EOD today. Proposed tasks: 1) infra fix (TTL bounds + tests) 2) monitoring/alerts + anomaly detection 3) runbook + playbook 4) quantized fallback policy 5) retro doc + customer comms

Ajay: I'll take infra fix (1). Will open a ticket and put an estimate. Target 2026-03-27. @mike can you be reviewer? :thumbsup:

ops-bot: RED-4123 created by Ajay - "cache: enforce TTL bounds and add unit tests" https://jira.redwood/RED-4123

Rachel: I'll own (3) runbook + playbook. Drafting checklist now and will link RED-4124. Need Ajay to paste expected test steps + failing repros.

Mike: I can handle monitoring/alerts (2) and anomaly rules. Creating RED-4125. Will coordinate with infra on metric names and thresholds. Proposed RACI for the set: Ajay (R), Rachel (A for docs), Mike (A for alerts), Sara (I)

Luis: I'm out for most of next week but can be backup owner for infra handoff. Also suggest a recurring-incident tracking ticket: RED-4126 to capture pattern + monthly review.

Sara: Let's put owners + deadlines here so ops and SRE can follow: Ajay -> infra (due 2026-03-27), Mike -> monitoring (due 2026-03-30), Rachel -> runbook (due 2026-04-03), Quantized fallback -> unassigned (goal 2026-04-10), Retro doc + comms -> Sara (due 2026-03-29).

Ajay: Confirming dates. I'll add acceptance criteria to RED-4123: unit tests for TTL bounds, an integration load check < baseline latency, and a post-deploy snapshot of eviction rates.

Mike: Need a short pairing session with Ajay tomorrow 11:00am PST to align metrics and test harness. @ajay please confirm availability.

Ajay: Confirmed 11:00am PST. I'll bring the reproducer and the test harness commands: ``make repro-eviction && python tests/test_ttl_bounds.py``

Rachel: I'll post a runbook template + checklist in RED-4124 and include play steps, verification, and rollback notes. Planning to include a short KB for Customer Support.

Sara: I'll be A for customer comms and closure. Please add yourself to the 'owner' field on the Jira ticket and ping #ops when the ticket is ready for review. I'll collate status updates and send a 48h follow-up. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: Reminder - oncall rotation next week: Mike -> Luis. If handoff required file REM-HANDOFF and @ops.

Mike: Noted. If Ajay finishes infra before rotation, I'll take the rollout to reduce fragmentation. Otherwise Luis will step in as backup.

Luis: Got it. I'll check RED-4123 context before rotation. Will keep availability in calendar.

Sara: Quick RACI recap (one-liner): Ajay - Responsible for infra fix; Mike - Accountable for alerts; Rachel - Accountable for docs/runbook; Sara - Accountable for comms; Luis - Informed/backup.

Ajay: I'll attach a short PR checklist to RED-4123 and mark it 'needs-review' when ready.

Rachel: Adding acceptance criteria to RED-4124 for runbook: clear steps, smoke tests, and escalation contacts.

Sara: Thanks all — I'll post an update in the postmortem doc and schedule a 48h check-in. If anyone can't meet their deadline, call it out here so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
